phase: V0.9 ingestion — inventory only. Nothing here has been written into the site yet.

sources.note: Cognitive/philosophical profile written about Siddhesh. 32 numbered sections. Contains the 11 conceptual anchors verbatim.
Near-duplicate of S1 in prompt form. Used only to corroborate.
CV-style summary. Experience, projects, skills, themes, anchors.
RICHEST SOURCE. Handover prompt containing ~51 of Siddhesh's original quotes verbatim, explicitly marked 'preserve these originals separately from any polished version'.
17 repos, 4 pinned: Claude-skills, automation-portfolio, statelab (Rust), Shuffle (Python).

findings.detail: RevenuePilot OS and FlowMail do not appear in any source. I invented them in V0.2–V0.8. They must be removed. StateLab is real (a Rust repo) but I invented its description.

Essentially ALL current node text is placeholder I wrote. Four ideas coincidentally match real anchors (value>money, consistent execution, desire→justification, boundaries are tools); everything else is mine, not his.

POLITICS / RELIGION / SOCIETY has no MIG, yet it is one of the largest bodies of real material (~14 objects: party tribalism, performative neutrality, terrorism as extremism, religion→rigidity, tax, voter incentives). Currently homeless. Needs a 14th MIG or an explicit decision to route it through OBSERVATION.
MUSIC has zero source material. Every Music concept currently on the site is invented. Either Siddhesh supplies material or the MIG should be held empty.
FOOD has exactly one real object (biryani + thecha). LOVE has three. Both are far thinner than their current build suggests.

Defence startup (kamikaze drones, Indian Army). S4 itself instructs: no operational details, no specifications, no tactical information, respect NDAs, 'use only information Siddhesh explicitly authorises for publication'. DO NOT PUBLISH without explicit written authorisation.
Dostoevsky and Hitchens quotes are flagged in S4 as needing attribution verification before publishing. Wrigley and Zanuck attributions also uncertain.

Several originals are jokes, provocations or rhetorical exaggerations, not beliefs. S4 explicitly warns against treating every statement as an absolute truth. The site's `state` field must carry this — see 'register' below.

register_note: S4 distinguishes: philosophical proposition / observation / deliberately provocative / joke / personal belief / unfinished thought / rhetorical exaggeration. Recommend adding a `register` field alongside `state` so the site never presents a joke as a belief.

objects.title: Knowledge should not be trapped in disciplines
objects.quote: One of the most intriguing things we did to the field of Knowledge is to divide it into different parts… When life and the Universe present themselves to us, they usually don't ask what subject we pursued in our college. Life comes in a package and we must accept it with utter curiosity.

objects.title: Money is a claim on value
objects.quote: When people say 'You can't make money without money', it's mostly because they confuse money with something that is some magical wand, when in reality Money is like a value claim ticket of 'Value'…
objects.note: Two versions. The refinement from 'embodiment' to 'claim ticket' is itself the intellectual content.

objects.title: Every day, both doors are open
objects.quote: Every day, life gives you a reason to be sad. And every day, it gives you a reason to be excited about the future as well… Every single day, both doors are open at the same time. And in the end, I guess your happiness just depends on which one you keep walking through.
objects.note: Siddhesh explicitly chose this final version and explicitly did NOT want it shortened. The 'I guess' is intentional.

objects.title: The parallel self
objects.quote: Nothing hurts more to a man than the fact that he's not what he could've been at this point in time. That he's years behind his best self from the parallel dimension.
objects.note: SENSITIVE-PERSONAL. A longer, rawer passage exists about sleeplessness and self-disgust. Publish only with explicit approval; consider the shorter form.

objects.title: God, agency and extraordinary action
objects.quote: Once a man realises there is no god, there is no one in the sky coming to save him, he then becomes capable of committing God level actions
objects.note: S4: do not frame as an argument that atheism produces greatness. Proposition, not claim.

objects.title: Poor mindset vs rich mindset

objects.note: S4 caveat: useful observation, not a psychological law.
